releaseNotes: The chain stops retrying models that cannot serve this app: a model that left the free tier, or whose answers this app always rejects, is remembered and skipped, and forgotten as soon as a fresh discovery list arrives. Discovery now reads the provider's whole response - OpenRouter returns about 736 KB and the app read only 256 KB, so it fell back to a stale list whose models had gone. And when every provider fails, the error names the cause and the next step instead of dumping eight lines.
